integrity: Proof supplied for all n>=3 and arbitrary characteristic; independent exact finite checker checks n=3,...,7 and is not used to infer an infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Reduced singular support and generic transverse singularities only; no claim about singular subschemes or all intersection-local analytic types. Earlier poset and stable-set toric literature covers foundational objects and normality but no equivalent component/nerve classification was found in inspected sources; other literature may exist.
title: Conifold components and path-independence incidence in stable-set toric varieties of paths
